title: Figaro Assembly (written and pinned forms)
description: The shape of an assembly's document — the agreements composed for one design, one per order, each binding a registered agreement and carrying its own topology, beside the designer's words and the designer's answers. The document has two forms with one shape. WRITTEN: each entry names the written agreement it binds (`agreement`, a file name under `agreements/`) and the entries it follows (`follows`, `agreement-<j>` labels), and `assemblyClauses` are written by clause name, as the files under `assemblies/` do; the reference builder is `composeAuthoredProcessDesign` (sdk/src/projection.ts), which binds each named agreement's hash and carries `follows` over. PINNED: each entry carries the bound agreement's `agreementHash` (the `AgreementRegistry` key), its own fills by clause key, and `follows`, the labels of the entries it follows, hashed into its leaf; the `processDesignHash` is the merkle root over the agreement leaves (`processDesignHashOf`, sdk/src/assembly.ts), the key `ProcessRegistry` takes, recomputed by every reader from the fetched bytes. The editorial fields and the designer's answers are excluded from the hash. A conformance test (sdk/tests/documents/schema-conformance.test.ts) keeps this schema and the builder in lockstep over the reference files. The schema is OPEN (additionalProperties allowed): unknown fields are tolerated and ignored by conforming readers.

name.description: The designer's own words, for a reader; never part of the hash.

summary.description: One sentence a stranger reads first; never part of the hash.

description.description: The designer's longer telling; never part of the hash.

faq.description: Questions a designer answers about the assembly, in plain words; never part of the hash.

deployTimeCurrency.description: WRITTEN form only: the deployment's own address that fills the denomination pin the file leaves unfilled, in place of the deployment's token, named by its key in deployments/<chainId>.json (`{ "deployment": "florinToken" }` pins the deployment's own FlorinToken). Read at seeding by `deployTimeCurrencyOf` (sdk/src/projection.ts); `composeAuthoredProcessDesign` drops it, so it enters no hash and no pinned document — only the address it resolves to does, through the pin.

assemblyClauses.description: The clauses composed once for the whole design (a clause whose `block.design.scope` is `assembly`), keyed as the agreement document keys its clauses, each value the designer's fills.

agreements.description: One entry per order of the design, in commit order. The first is the root, which follows nothing; every other names the entries it follows by label.

agreementLabel.description: The entry's label within the assembly, `agreement-<index>`, the target `follows` names. Not a chain id and not a party: the assembly is party-agnostic.

agreement.description: The written agreement this entry binds: a file name under `agreements/`, without its extension.

follows.description: The entries this order follows; empty or absent on the root.

agreementHash.description: The registered agreement this entry binds: the merkle root over its composed clauses, the `AgreementRegistry` key.

clauses.description: The entry's own fills over the registered agreement, by clause key, merged over the agreement's clauses at checkout (the entry's fill wins for the keys it names); `{}` when the entry fills none.

follows.description: The entries this order follows, by label; empty or absent on the root. Part of the entry's leaf bytes (`agreementLeafBytes`), and written at checkout into each order's topology leaf as the order hashes of those entries' orders.
